subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this coordinated update of third-party Actions in workflows that mint tokens, use secrets, publish releases, and invoke Codex?
rationale: The patch is mechanically limited to pinned external action revisions, but deciding to trust new code at these privileged call sites is a repository-owner security decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve the reviewed pins
options.body: Accept the grouped Dependabot update after the workflow/security owner reviews the upstream action changes and required checks succeed.

options.title: Split privileged suppliers
options.body: Land low-privilege workflow updates separately and defer app-token, release, Docker, and Codex action pins for focused review.

options.title: Defer this group bump
options.body: Pause the update if the project prefers one supplier or privileged workflow family per dependency-review PR.

recommendation.title: Approve the reviewed pins
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped Dependabot update after the workflow/security owner reviews the upstream action changes and required checks succeed.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate for a repository-wide workflow trust-boundary decision.
